changes: Garden package and community tool suites use actual SqliteApi/native SQLite; all twelve existing cases remain, with eight native refusal/ownership cases added.
Package entry points require the native archive/content/membership commands; retired settings import, runtime hydration and cache substitution are removed.
Conflict lookups only classify NotFoundError as absence and include occupied trashed/root identities.
The actual API validates all incoming member bytes and matching single root identities before Garden or member admission.
Restore preserves the Garden UUID and member UUIDs in a clean installation. Copy provenance is saved in Garden metadata and survives actual API restart.

Native content is deduplicated once across member archives, including history and copied outputs; reconstruction restores native content paths. Existing shipped self-contained archive3 undertaking packages remain supported.
Chooser values, destination and caller ArrayBuffer bytes are captured before asynchronous intake.
Community tests read the full file reference returned by the edit and use actual publication UUIDs.
The displaced chosen-identity settings insertion has no callers and is deleted; tracked renderer SQL mutation sites drop from60 to59.
baselines: Native community baseline: one obsolete ID-only read failed and four cases passed; mutation returns the correct new reference.

Initial package native baseline: three failed/two passed. Conflict inspection swallowed actual table-read refusal; a mismatched declared member UUID imported with false lineage. The import-read case surfaced a later generic error rather than the expected owner read refusal.
The original missing-content cleanup case passed; the stronger final case adds a one-shot trusted folder-preparation refusal to prove invalid bytes refuse before host intake.
Ownership baseline: one failure/seven passes. Caller mutation changed the imported name from Captured name to Changed later; the final case verifies captured name and actual original parent.
Full gate caught three TypeScript issues in the new fixture/union/row typing, then a stale persistence inventory after deletion. Types and the reviewed inventory are corrected before acceptance.
limits: Garden wrapper members still admit sequentially with compensating cleanup, not one atomic selected-Garden transaction. Cleanup refusal and operation-wide capture need the coordinated follow-through.
Generic Crux IO still holds format1/2 serializers. Generic format/installation tests, required command interfaces and Task/Garden/worker/schema retirement remain.
AR06 and AR07–AR09 are unfinished. This stage does not claim v1 release completion.
No API/runtime, live hosted publication, deployment, merge, real Garden or manual-candidate changes. New-head native CI remains separate.
